gemini.rationale: The customer-facing product (residential communities) and operational processes transferred together, so gap_45 is 0. However, all officers and directors departed at closing, and the integration plan was undeveloped, creating a structural mismatch between the transferred operations (T5) and the departing management/organization (T6), so gap_56 is 1. There was no transition-services agreement disclosed to mitigate this gap.

grok.rationale: gap_45 is 0 because the slice’s structural summary states the customer-facing product (active-adult and primary residential communities) continued together with the surviving AV Homes legal vehicle in a whole-company reverse triangular merger, with no product-vs-process structural mismatch documented at closing. gap_56 is 1 because at the Effective Time all AV Homes officers and directors ceased (Form 8-K Item 5.02) while operations transferred with the surviving entity and the integration plan remained undeveloped at signing, bridged only by optional NEO consulting and a retention-program allowance; the filing discloses no transition-services agreement absorbing that org/process mismatch.

openai.rationale: AV Homes was acquired whole, including its customer-facing residential communities and the operations that produced and delivered them, so no product-process gap is documented at closing. However, all pre-closing officers and directors ceased serving at the effective time while operational integration was still being developed, creating a documented process-organization mismatch; only optional executive consulting and employee-retention provisions were disclosed, not a transition-services or shared-services agreement. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-18-258270, DEFM14A] [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-18-291002, Form 8-K]
